env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w

# A member imported under an alias decodes: the generated code spells it with
# the file's own import name.
logos run ./alias
stdout '^alias circle r=3$'
stdout '^alias local s=4$'

# A member package the holder never imports decodes: the lowering adds the import.
logos run ./unimported
stdout '^unimported m\.A \{X:5\}$'
stdout '^unimported m\.B \{Y:y\}$'

# Two member packages with one name and one type name keep separate key sets.
logos run ./samename
stdout '^samename a r=1$'
stdout '^samename b s=2$'

# A union that names an imported union decodes and encodes only its members,
# whatever the position, and a union that an imported package builds from
# another package's union does the same.
logos run ./matrix
! stdout 'FAIL'
stdout '^ok n-field$'
stdout '^ok n-slice$'
stdout '^ok n-map$'
stdout '^ok n-nomember$'
stdout '^ok n-marshal$'
stdout '^ok v-field$'
stdout '^ok v-slice$'
stdout '^ok v-map$'
stdout '^ok v-nomember$'
stdout '^ok v-marshal$'
stdout '^ok u-field$'
stdout '^ok u-slice$'
stdout '^ok u-map$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/jq

go 1.27

-- w/shape/shape.lgo --
package shape

type Circle struct {
	R int64 `json:"r"`
}

-- w/alias/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	xs "example.com/jq/shape"
)

type Local struct {
	S int64 `json:"s"`
}

type U interface {
	xs.Circle | Local
}

type H struct {
	V U `json:"v"`
}

func show(input string) {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	switch v := h.V.(type) {
	case xs.Circle:
		fmt.Printf("alias circle r=%d\n", v.R)
	case Local:
		fmt.Printf("alias local s=%d\n", v.S)
	case nil:
		fmt.Println("alias nil")
	}
}

func main() {
	show(`{"v":{"r":3}}`)
	show(`{"v":{"s":4}}`)
}

-- w/m/m.lgo --
package m

type A struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

type B struct {
	Y string `json:"y"`
}

-- w/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/jq/m"

type U interface {
	m.A | m.B
}

-- w/unimported/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/jq/u"
)

type H struct {
	V u.U `json:"v"`
}

func show(input string) {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Printf("unimported %T %+v\n", h.V, h.V)
}

func main() {
	show(`{"v":{"x":5}}`)
	show(`{"v":{"y":"y"}}`)
}

-- w/a/shape/shape.lgo --
package shape

type Item struct {
	R int64 `json:"r"`
}

-- w/b/shape/shape.lgo --
package shape

type Item struct {
	S int64 `json:"s"`
}

-- w/samename/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	a "example.com/jq/a/shape"
	b "example.com/jq/b/shape"
)

type U interface {
	a.Item | b.Item
}

type H struct {
	V U `json:"v"`
}

func show(input string) {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	switch v := h.V.(type) {
	case a.Item:
		fmt.Printf("samename a r=%d\n", v.R)
	case b.Item:
		fmt.Printf("samename b s=%d\n", v.S)
	case nil:
		fmt.Println("samename nil")
	}
}

func main() {
	show(`{"v":{"r":1}}`)
	show(`{"v":{"s":2}}`)
}

-- w/v/v.lgo --
package v

import "example.com/jq/u"

type C struct {
	Z int64 `json:"z"`
}

type V interface {
	u.U | C
}

-- w/matrix/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"slices"

	"example.com/jq/u"
	"example.com/jq/v"
)

type L struct {
	Q int64 `json:"q"`
}

type N interface {
	u.U | L
}

type HN struct {
	F N            `json:"f"`
	S []N          `json:"s"`
	M map[string]N `json:"m"`
}

type HV struct {
	F v.V            `json:"f"`
	S []v.V          `json:"s"`
	M map[string]v.V `json:"m"`
}

type HU struct {
	F u.U            `json:"f"`
	S []u.U          `json:"s"`
	M map[string]u.U `json:"m"`
}

func nameOf(x any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%T", x)
}

func check(name string, got, want []string) {
	if slices.Equal(got, want) {
		fmt.Println("ok", name)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("FAIL", name, got, want)
}

func must(name string, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL", name, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func checkN() {
	nIn := `{"f":{"x":5},"s":[{"x":1},{"y":"b"},{"q":3}],"m":{"a":{"y":"c"},"b":{"q":4}}}`
	var hn HN
	must("n-decode", json.Unmarshal([]byte(nIn), &hn))
	check("n-field", []string{nameOf(hn.F)}, []string{"m.A"})
	var ns []string
	for _, e := range hn.S {
		ns = append(ns, nameOf(e))
	}
	check("n-slice", ns, []string{"m.A", "m.B", "main.L"})
	var nm []string
	for k, e := range hn.M {
		nm = append(nm, k+"="+nameOf(e))
	}
	slices.Sort(nm)
	check("n-map", nm, []string{"a=m.B", "b=main.L"})
	out, err := json.Marshal(hn)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL n-encode", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	check("n-marshal", []string{string(out)}, []string{nIn})
	var none HN
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"f":{"w":1}}`), &none); err == nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL n-nomember", nameOf(none.F))
	} else {
		fmt.Println("ok n-nomember")
	}
}

func checkV() {
	vIn := `{"f":{"z":1},"s":[{"x":1},{"y":"b"},{"z":2}],"m":{"a":{"y":"c"},"b":{"z":4}}}`
	var hv HV
	must("v-decode", json.Unmarshal([]byte(vIn), &hv))
	check("v-field", []string{nameOf(hv.F)}, []string{"v.C"})
	var vs []string
	for _, e := range hv.S {
		vs = append(vs, nameOf(e))
	}
	check("v-slice", vs, []string{"m.A", "m.B", "v.C"})
	var vm []string
	for k, e := range hv.M {
		vm = append(vm, k+"="+nameOf(e))
	}
	slices.Sort(vm)
	check("v-map", vm, []string{"a=m.B", "b=v.C"})
	out, err := json.Marshal(hv)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL v-encode", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	check("v-marshal", []string{string(out)}, []string{vIn})
	var vnone HV
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"f":{"w":1}}`), &vnone); err == nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL v-nomember", nameOf(vnone.F))
	} else {
		fmt.Println("ok v-nomember")
	}
}

func checkU() {
	uIn := `{"f":{"x":5},"s":[{"x":1},{"y":"b"}],"m":{"a":{"y":"c"}}}`
	var hu HU
	must("u-decode", json.Unmarshal([]byte(uIn), &hu))
	check("u-field", []string{nameOf(hu.F)}, []string{"m.A"})
	var us []string
	for _, e := range hu.S {
		us = append(us, nameOf(e))
	}
	check("u-slice", us, []string{"m.A", "m.B"})
	var um []string
	for k, e := range hu.M {
		um = append(um, k+"="+nameOf(e))
	}
	slices.Sort(um)
	check("u-map", um, []string{"a=m.B"})
}

func main() {
	checkN()
	checkV()
	checkU()
}
